facts.statement: Tesla's first store in Argentina was inaugurated on 20 November 2026, as recorded in the official Casa Rosada launch address.
facts.sourceTitle: Casa Rosada — Tesla launch address, 20 November 2026

facts.statement: Registered new residential rental contracts in Barcelona municipality fell from 51,294 in 2019 to 30,789 in 2025, a decrease of about 40.0% relative to 2019.
facts.sourceTitle: Generalitat de Catalunya — municipal rental-contract workbook

facts.statement: For Spain's 29 November 2026 general election, eligible CERA voters sending their postal vote from abroad to their consular office must dispatch it no later than 24 November 2026.
facts.sourceTitle: Interior / La Moncloa — voting from abroad, 20 November 2026

facts.statement: On 21 November 2026, Pedro Sánchez announced that the next Council of Ministers would extend the bank tax into 2027, projecting €1.4 billion in revenue to be allocated to housing policies.
As of 21 November 2026, Atenea had published a November 2026 report titled 'Votar con criterio', presented as a voting guide for Spain's 29 November election.
facts.sourceTitle: Atenea — Votar con criterio, November 2026 edition
